scenarios.name: upkeep-cloaks-the-top-card-face-down
scenarios.why: At the beginning of upkeep the may-trigger cloaks the top library card: the Grizzly Bears move onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature.

scenarios.name: face-down-creature-enters-with-a-flying-counter
scenarios.why: The enchantment's static makes face-down creatures the controller's control enter with a flying counter: the manifested Grizzly Bears arrive carrying one.
